headline: 16 Bangladeshis killed in devastating Saudi sofa factory fire in Riyadh
summary: The fire broke out yesterday afternoon at a sofa factory in Riyadh's Musa Industrial Area. Rescue operations are ongoing, and officials are working to identify the victims.
details: At least 16 Bangladeshi nationals were killed in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, yesterday afternoon. The incident occurred around 2:00 PM at a sofa factory located in the Musa Industrial Area under the Al-Shifa police station.

The Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Ministry confirmed the deaths in a notification, quoting fire service personnel. Witnesses at the scene reported that all the victims were from Bangladesh.

Rescue operations were still underway when the notification was issued early today, Bangladesh time. The Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh has expressed deep sorrow and is in close contact with Saudi authorities to identify the victims.

Earlier reports from Expatriates’ Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury mentioned seven Bangladeshi workers from Naogaon’s Atrai upazila among the casualties. This information was later updated to reflect the higher death toll of 16.

headline_marked: [[SSC and equivalent exam results published today]], August 10. Re-scrutiny applications open August 11.
headline: SSC and equivalent exam results published today, August 10. Re-scrutiny applications open August 11.
summary: Students can access their results online, via SMS, or from their respective educational institutions. The re-scrutiny application period runs from August 11 to August 17.
details: The wait for this year's SSC and equivalent examination results concludes today, Monday, August 10. Education Minister Dr. A.N.M. Ehsanul Hoque Milon will officially inaugurate the results at 10 AM in a ceremony at the Ministry of Education conference room.

At the same time, candidates will be able to check their results online, through their educational institutions, and via mobile SMS. This information was announced by the Ministry of Education in a notice on Sunday, August 9.

Results will be available on the respective education board websites, as well as two common websites: eduboardresult.gov.bd and educationboardresults.gov.bd. Students can also collect their results directly from their schools.

To receive results via SMS, students should type 'SSC' followed by a space, the first three letters of their board name, their roll number, and the examination year, then send it to 16140. For example, 'SSC DHA 123456 2023'.

A total of 1,857,344 students filled out forms to participate in this year's SSC and equivalent examinations. This includes 1,418,398 students under the general education boards, 304,286 for Dakhil exams, and 134,660 for SSC (Vocational) exams.
Meanwhile, applications for result re-scrutiny will be accepted from August 11 to August 17. The Bangladesh Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee announced this on Saturday.

The online re-scrutiny application process and related instructions will be published on the education boards' websites. Educational institutions can download and publish results using their EIIN on the designated website.
